thread.title: Can Amazon Beat Apple On Path To Reaching $1 Trillion Valuation?

author: BRIAN DEAGON
title: Can Amazon Beat Apple On Path To Reaching $1 Trillion Valuation?
text:
Amazon ( AMZN ) is on a path to a $1 trillion market value and is also on track to handle about 50% of all U.S. e-commerce spending by next year, said a Wall Street analyst in a report Monday.
X Amazon is worth between $900 billion to $1 trillion, wrote GBH Insights analyst Daniel Ives in a research note to clients. He estimates Amazon's core consumer e-commerce business is worth between $600 billion to $650 billion and values its Amazon Web Services cloud-computing business at $300 billion to $350 billion, getting it to a market capitalization at $1 trillion.
"We believe the path is now set for this to occur over the next 12 to 18 months as the (Amazon) strategic path both on the consumer and enterprise fronts are still in the middle innings of playing out," Ives wrote.
No U.S. company has reached a $1 trillion valuation yet, but Apple ( AAPL ) has come the closest. Apple currently has a market valuation of $903 billion, while Amazon is at $734 billion.
If Amazon had a market value of $1 trillion today, the stock would be trading at 2,016. That's a premium of 33% from where the stock currently trades. Shares of Apple would need to rise 11%, to 197, for it to reach a market value of $1 trillion.
Amazon shares climbed 1.5% to close at 1,521.95 on the stock market today . Apple stock gained 2% to 178.97.
IBD'S TAKE: Amazon is a longtime member of IBD'S exclusive Leaderboard , which tracks the top-performing stocks. Amazon has been making new highs, but the stock remains extended from the 1,231.51 buy point. 
The core consumer business of Amazon, coupled with its cloud computing unit, should translate into significant earnings power and expansion, wrote Ives, who raised his price target on Amazon to 1,850 from 1,500.
Ives is not the first to project a $1 trillion market value for Amazon. Morgan Stanley analyst Brian Nowak estimated that Amazon would reach that level by the end of this year.
Drexel Hamilton analyst Brian White in January issued a report on Apple saying it was worth $1 trillion. Ives laid out a bull case scenario for Apple in November, reaching a $1 trillion valuation.
Looking ahead, said Ives, the key jewel for Amazon is its Prime membership program, where customers pay $99 a year to receive free shipping and numerous other perks. Ives estimates there are now about 90 million Prime members, who spend about twice the amount on Amazon than nonmembers. Being able to provide Prime members cross-selling services connected with Whole Foods will also create a barrier against competitors, such as Walmart ( WMT ), wrote Ives.
Amazon and Walmart are in a major battle that will define the future of retailing. While Amazon's biggest pure play competitor, Walmart, has done a commendable job beefing up its e-commerce strategy Amazon continues to have an "iron grip" on the e-commerce market, wrote Ives.
Amazon has also scored a beachhead product with its Echo line of smart speakers, which are quickly becoming the core foundation of smart homes and opening up new growth opportunities around retail, search, and advertising.
